summary: The Organization of PJM States moves for an 11-day extension of the comment deadline on PJM's Interim Resource Adequacy Service and Large Load Registry filing. PJM does not oppose the motion.
ask: Extend the comment deadline in ER26-3515 from September 3 to September 14, 2026, with action by September 1.

points.point: OPSI asks to move comments from September 3 to September 14, 2026, and PJM does not oppose.
points.quote: OPSI requests that the Commission extend the time for comments in this docket from September 3, 2026 to September 14, 2026.

points.point: PJM's August 13 filing proposes a load reduction service for new large loads and a large load registry.
points.quote: a new supplemental capacity product through which New Large Loads [(“NLL”)] provide a load reduction service that is a tool available to PJM to manage resource adequacy shortfalls

points.point: PJM's compensation mechanism creates new obligations for Electric Distributors and touches retail ratemaking.
points.quote: PJM proposes a compensation mechanism for loads that provide this new service, which creates new obligations for Electric Distributors.

points.point: State regulators need time to assess the interaction of PJM, distributors and retail regulators in implementing the service.
points.quote: to allow the retail regulators in the PJM region additional time to consider the complex interaction between the rights and responsibilities of PJM, Electric Distributors, and retail regulators

throughLine.text: Moves the comment schedule in PJM's separate interim resource adequacy docket ER26-3515, PJM's proposal on how to serve load that outpaces capacity, the subject of the E-7 adequacy report.
